subject.title: fix(doctor): bound AGENTS.md and root-memory file reads

question: Should doctor preserve the current behavior of following symlinked workspace memory files, or intentionally adopt a no-symlink policy?
rationale: The reader choice changes both filesystem-safety policy and persistent-memory upgrade behavior, so automation cannot select the permanent contract.

options.title: Preserve current behavior
options.body: Use a bounded, race-aware read path that supports the currently accepted symlink contract and add symlink regression coverage.

options.title: Adopt no-symlink policy
options.body: Reject symlinked memory before moving memory.md, retain an actionable recovery path, and document the compatibility change.

recommendation.title: Preserve current behavior
recommendation.body: Use a bounded, race-aware read path that supports the currently accepted symlink contract and add symlink regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and repeatedly maintained the doctor workspace behavior whose path contract is affected.
